claims.statement: For the OR of k=2^r disjoint r-bit point defects and one exposed physical selector bit, Delta_s U/Inf_s=1+2r2^-r+O(2^-r), while the complete increment Q_s/Inf_s=1-2r^2 2^-r+O(r2^-r).
